data.long_meaning: Adlaa is derived from the Arabic root 'Adl', meaning 'justice' or 'equity'. It is a name rooted in spiritual values and symbolizes a strong sense of fairness, morality, and righteousness. The name Adlaa carries the meaning “Justice, Equity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adlaa usually hope their child will grow to embody justice, equity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
